html:
tokentrim 75% history reduction

tokentrim trims Claude Code history so you read far less of the past conversation. Install the full version and the compaction window cuts re‑read by about 75 %.

How it works for a single Claude Code session

  1. Clone the repo or add the plugin.
  2. Run your Claude Code prompt as usual.
  3. tokentrim summarizes earlier turns automatically.
  4. The replay command shows the exact reduction you achieved.

What you get and the cost

  • Free local toolkit: all hooks, three strength profiles, replay command, dashboard, daily‑budget guard, cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro upgrade (lifetime $49 for the first 500 buyers or $9 / month) adds a hosted dashboard usable on any device, a Monday digest, weekly budget alerts at 80 %, Slack totals, and support for up to three machines.
  • Nothing leaves your machine unless you enable the hosted dashboard.

FAQ

Does the free version include the compaction window? No. The compaction window that delivers the 75 % reduction is only in the full install (git clone).

Will tokentrim work on my computer? It requires Python 3.9 or newer and runs on macOS and Linux.

How can I see the savings for my own runs? Use the replay command; it prints the exact percentage of history trimmed and the cost reduction.

Get started with tokentrim now
